chapter: Early bands and New Orleans musicians
title: Eddie Edwards and Jackson School
summary: They discuss Eddie Edwards, who played violin for marching at Jackson School.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: I wanted to tell you before I forget it. I saw Eddie Edwards a couple of months ago.
Yeah, he was a trombone player.
He looks like he's doing pretty well.
Yeah. He used to play violin when I was going to school. He used to play the march for us to march up in the room on violin.

blocks.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)

blocks.x: Jackson, on PepsiCo Magazine. Oh, yeah.

blocks.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
blocks.x: He must be old then if he's old. Well, that's how old he is.
He's old as I am every bit of it if not older.
